### Concrete Evidence

1. **50% Parent Preview Sizing & Edge Anchoring**
   - **Left Split** (Top-Left capture): Anchored flush at `inset-y-0 left-0 w-1/2`, occupying precisely the left 50% width and 100% height of the pane.
   - **Right Split** (Top-Right capture): Anchored flush at `inset-y-0 right-0 w-1/2`, occupying precisely the right 50% width and 100% height of the pane.
   - **Top Split** (Bottom-Left capture): Anchored flush at `inset-x-0 top-0 h-1/2`, occupying precisely 100% width and top 50% height of the pane.
   - **Bottom Split** (Bottom-Right capture): Anchored flush at `inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-1/2`, occupying precisely 100% width and bottom 50% height of the pane.

2. **Hit Zone (20%) vs Visual Preview Separation**
   - Separate DOM node for hit target (`div[data-split-edge-drop-zone="true"]`) maintaining isolated 20% collision strips (`inset-y-0 left-0 w-[20%]`, `inset-y-0 right-0 w-[20%]`, `left-[20%] right-[20%] top-0 h-[20%]`, `bottom-0 left-[20%] right-[20%] h-[20%]`).
   - Distinct preview node (`div[data-split-edge-preview="true"]`) rendered only when `isOver` is active, cleanly separating interaction hitboxes from visual feedback.

3. **Outline, Styling, & Clipping**
   - Visible 2px primary border outline (`border-2 border-primary`) with subtle fill (`bg-primary/20 backdrop-blur-[1px]`) rendered crisply across all 4 directions.
   - No clipping anomalies or border leaks beyond the parent pane boundaries.

4. **Label Placement**
   - Pill badge `<span data-testid="split-edge-drop-feedback">` ("New split") is consistently anchored to the bottom-left (`absolute bottom-2 left-2 rounded-sm bg-background/80 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-foreground shadow-sm`) of each preview box with clear contrast.

5. **Reusability Across Pane and Group Targets**
   - `SplitEdgeDropZone` accepts union data `GroupEdgeDropData | PaneEdgeDropData`.
   - Used uniformly by `TabGroupDropSurface.tsx` (`group-edge`) and `PaneEdgeDropZones.tsx` (`pane-edge`), ensuring identical hit contracts and visual feedback.
   - Vitest suite in `ui/src/components/tab-dnd/SplitEdgeDropZone.test.tsx` passes 6/6 tests.
